info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Retrieval API allows users to access specific term deposit framework agreements based on unique parameters. This operation provides detailed information regarding various deposit lending options, enabling financial institutions to better serve their clients. It is primarily utilized by banking software and applications seeking to present tailored lending solutions to customers. Typical consumers of this API include banking professionals, loan processing systems, and financial advisory platforms that require precise lending details. Leverage this API for efficient integration of deposit lending insights into your services.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific term deposit framework agreement.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about a specific term deposit framework agreement identified by its unique ID. It provides all the necessary details regarding the terms, conditions, and regulations associated with the agreement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the term deposit framework agreement details for the specified resource identifier (RES-100045). Ensure that you provide any necessary parameters for a successful operation. The data returned will be based on the specifics of the request made.
